_comment: Search Console truth for virtualagency-os.com, refreshed daily by distribution_scripts/gsc_search_intelligence.py (query-intelligence.yml) and committed.
queries/pages are the rolling 28-day window on the query and page dimensions asked for separately, so pages whose queries Search Console withholds are still measured.
query_history and page_history are additive and never shrink, so a target that leaves the window keeps the redirect and the ranking it earned.
Read by scripts/build_measured_404_redirects.js; gated by scripts/validators/validate_gsc_truth.js.

queries.query: questions to ask in a financial rfp
